title: Nashik Court Grants Bail to Five Accused in TCS Sexual Harassment Case
summary: A Nashik court granted bail to five accused individuals in a sexual harassment and forced conversion case involving Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). The court stated that there was no serious apprehension about the accused threatening witnesses or tampering with evidence if released. Five FIRs were mentioned, but no details on the charges were provided. The bail decision came as an investigation into the matter neared completion.
